{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1996 | image = | dates = 5 May – 1 September 1996 | teams = 21 | connacht = Galway | munster = Limerick | leinster = Wexford | ulster = Antrim | matches = 22 | poty = [[File: Colours of Wexford.svg|border|20px]] [[Larry O'Gorman]] | team = Wexford | titles = 6th | captain = [[Martin Storey]] | manager = [[Liam Griffin (hurling)|Liam Griffin]] | team2 = Limerick | captain2 = [[Ciarán Carey]] | manager2 = [[Tom Ryan (Limerick hurler)|Tom Ryan]] | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = [[File: Colours of Limerick.svg|border|20px]] [[Gary Kirby]] (1–35) | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1995|1995]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1997|1997]] }} The '''1996 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 110th staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier inter-county hurling tournament. The draw for the various provincial championships took place on 22 October 1995. The championship ran from 5 May to 1 September 1996. [[Clare GAA|Clare]] were the [[1995 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]], however, they were beaten by [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] in the [[#Munster semi-finals|Munster semi-finals]].{{cite web|url=https://www.gaa.ie/hurling/news/watch-jubilee-1995-all-ireland-shc-final|title=WATCH: Jubilee 1995 All Ireland SHC Final|publisher=GAA website|date=26 December 2020|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}}{{cite web|url=https://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/2020/0416/1131994-clare-v-offaly-1995-hurling-final-live-updates/|title=Clare v Offaly – 1995 hurling All-Ireland final as it happened, again |publisher=RTÉ Sport|date=17 April 2020|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}}{{cite web|url=https://www.hoganstand.com/county/clare/article/index/243622|title=Twenty years since the 'Curse of Biddy Early' was lifted|publisher=RTÉ Sport|date=3 September 2015|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}}{{cite web|url=https://www.limerickpost.ie/2021/06/18/rewatchables-careys-magic-as-limericks-seal-1996-munster-semi-final-win-over-clare/|title=Rewatchables: Carey’s magic as Limerick’s seal 1996 Munster semi-final win over Clare|publisher=Limerick Post|date=18 June 2020|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}} The [[1996 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|All-Ireland final]] was played on 1 September 1996 at [[Croke Park]] in [[Dublin]], between [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] and Limerick, in what was their third meeting in the final overall, a first meeting in the final in [[1918 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|78 years]] and a first championship meeting in [[1955 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship#All-Ireland semi-finals|41 years]].{{cite web|url=https://sportinglimerick.com/__science_behind_limericks_1918_all-ireland/|title=A look back at the “Science” behind Limerick’s 1918 All-Ireland win|publisher=Sporting Limerick|date=4 June 2017|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}}{{cite web|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-40188420.html|title=The one that got away: Limeick's generation that never tasted All-Ireland success|publisher=Irish Examiner|date=11 December 2020|access-date=6 January 2025|first=|last=}} Wexford won the match by 1–13 to 0–14 to claim their sixth All-Ireland title overall and a first title in [[1968 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|26 years]]. Limerick's [[Gary Kirby]] was the championship's [[#Top scorers|top scorer]] with 1–35. Wexford's [[Larry O'Gorman]] was named Hurler of the Year.{{cite web|url=https://www.gaa.ie/hurling/news/pwc-all-stars-legends-larry-o-gorman|title=PwC All-Stars Legends – Larry O'Gorman|publisher=GAA
